defect: replicated broadcast buses can resemble a scalar-to-vector mismatch
rationale: The replication operators intentionally copy one input beat and its valid bit into every output lane. The reduction AND requires all output ready bits before accepting the source beat.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the broadcaster to its replicated data/valid outputs and all-consumers-ready handshake.

mutation.description: Replication and reduction operators intentionally expand one stream beat and combine all sink readiness signals.
